data.name: Dominar Sanctum
data.detailed_description:
EARLY PLAYTEST NOW LIVE

Dominar Sanctum is currently in active development, and an early playtest is now available to players who would like to experience the game and help shape its development.

The current build includes prototype versions of the first four campaign maps, as well as two skirmish maps, and showcases a number of the game's core systems, including dungeon management, exploration, third-person combat and the emerging campaign experience.

Please keep in mind that this is an early development build. Some systems, encounters and maps are still prototypes, balancing is ongoing, and you may encounter unfinished content, rough edges or bugs.

If you decide to join the playtest, constructive feedback is very welcome... particularly on gameplay, progression, map design and the overall experience.

Master the Sanctum

A Dark Fantasy Hybrid of Dungeon Management, RTS, and Third-Person Action.

Beneath the shadow of the Sanctum Mountains, an ancient power stirs. In Dominar Sanctum, you are not just a commander watching from above. You are the heart of the hive. Carve out your domain, breed loyal minions, and prepare to defend your territory against the powers that dwell in the deep.

Architect Your Domain

  • Build & Command: Architect your fortress from the ground up. Manage resources, expand your influence, and strategically place defenses to crush intruders.

  • Become What You Breed: Recruit a diverse army of minions. Every unit has a purpose, and your success depends on how you shape and lead your forces.

Seize Direct Control

  • Direct Possession: Take total control. At any moment, leap into the perspective of your Champions or possess your minions to turn the tide of battle in visceral third-person combat.

  • Hybrid Warfare: Seamlessly blend high-level RTS strategy with real-time spellcasting and melee action. Lead from the throne, or fight from the mud.

Claim Your Throne

The depths are calling. Will you rise as the ultimate ruler of the Sanctum, or fall to the shadows?

Wishlist Dominar Sanctum now to begin your conquest.
